prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet for Wacha Wacha Town, a richly painted cute storybook miniature town game. Exactly THREE NEW distinct characters in THREE ROWS and EIGHT equal columns. 8x3 grid, transparent alpha, generous 15% completely clear gutters between EVERY cell. Soft dark outlines, compact chibi bodies with clear faces, three-quarter elevated right-facing view. Each row preserves one character's exact face, outfit, proportions, size and baseline through eight FULL BODY poses. Row 1: elderly, medium height, sturdy muscular ocean-research photographer with a round navy brimmed bucket hat over cropped silver hair, square blue camera bag, a rounded slate-blue vest with long tails over cream shirt, trousers and practical boots. He has a clean-shaven strong chin and round nose; no long moustache. Row 2: elderly muscular airship sailcloth repairer with close-cropped gray hair, distinctive rectangular glasses, a wide ochre waist sash, blue work shirt with tiered hem, tan trousers and brown boots; carries a small folded pale sailcloth and sewing kit. Row 3: young adult lanky theatrical thief with short chestnut hair, short round beard, an angular dark burgundy vest over charcoal shirt, narrow trousers and soft shoes, small black eye mask; carries a small tied fabric bag. Columns 1-4 of EVERY row: real four-frame WALK loop with left leg forward, passing feet, right leg forward, opposite passing feet and coordinated arms. Columns 5-8 ACTION: row1 lifts a camera, looks through viewfinder, presses shutter, lowers camera. Row2 unfolds the small sailcloth in his hands, threads needle, stitches fabric, inspects seam. Row3 checks tied bag, peers left suspiciously, hugs bag, peers right suspiciously. Every cell contains ENTIRE head, body, two shoes and hand-held props, absolutely no clipping. Eight separate full people per row, 24 full-body cells total. No scenery, no tables, no text, no floor, no shadows. Do not merge characters or omit poses.
